title: Scalable REST API Backend

title: Containerized Microservices Cluster

title: Semantic Search Engine using RAG
description: Develop a high-performance vector search engine that parses document uploads, computes high-dimensional embeddings, stores them in FAISS, and runs grounded LLM query prompts.

title: Responsive Single Page Portfolio dashboard
description: Create a premium responsive UI dashboard showcasing live graphs, analytics, dark modes, animations, and clean state managements using modern frameworks.

title: Big Data ETL Pipeline

title: Enterprise Full Stack Commerce App
description: Implement a full stack web app featuring a secure dashboard, product catalogues, and payments checkout. Establish proper state storage, REST routes, and clean folder paths.
